This repository is a Telegram bot template combining aiogram 3, Django 5, and Celery. It is a starter scaffold with `/start` and automatic user tracking, intended for extension.

cp .env.example .env  # Then edit .env with your values
uv run python manage.py migrate
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py runserver
uv run python main.py
uv run celery -A config worker --loglevel=info
uv run python manage.py makemigrations
uv run python manage.py test
uv run python manage.py createsuperuser
uv run python manage.py shell

Key `.env` variables: `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` (required), `DJANGO_SECRET_KEY` (required), `CELERY_BROKER_URL`, `START_COMMAND_MESSAGE`.

`main.py` initializes Django ORM, configures aiogram Bot/Dispatcher, registers middleware/routes, and starts polling. `config/` contains Django settings, database configuration via `dj-database-url` (SQLite default), Celery, and admin. `bot/models.py` defines `TelegramUser`; `bot/aiogram/handlers.py` contains handlers; `bot/aiogram/middlewares.py` contains `UserTrackingMiddleware`; `bot/tasks.py` contains Celery tasks.

Add handlers to `bot/aiogram/handlers.py` or router modules included in `main.py:42`. Add models to `bot/models.py` and register them in `bot/admin.py`. Implement Celery tasks in `bot/tasks.py` using the `<REDACTED_USER>_task` decorator. Add environment variables to `.env.example` and access them via `config/settings.py`.

Uses `uv`; all commands should be run with `uv run python`. Admin: `/admin`. User interactions are automatically tracked. Celery requires Redis. Production use requires secret management and database configuration.
